segments.he:
תּוֹרָה רל
מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עֵינַיִם לִרְאוֹת יָכוֹל לִרְאוֹת וּלְהַכִּיר בְּהַפָּנִים שֶׁל הַתַּלְמִיד מִי הוּא רַבּוֹ, וּבִלְבַד כְּשֶׁרָאָה רַבּוֹ פַּעַם אַחַת:
segments.en: Pure thoughts are the aspect of pure animals — and evil thoughts are the aspect of impure animals. And the battle a person has in one's mind regarding thoughts is literally a battle between the pure and impure animals. And it is arranged with intention from above that they should defeat one another. For the Holy One, blessed be He, has great delight when they battle one another — and the person overpowers the impure animals and defeats them.
